notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Added "EASY MODE"

"EASY MODE" has its own ranking system. Let's pursue a high score!
The game mode of the previous difficulty level has been changed to "NORMAL MODE" and remains as difficult as ever.

Fixed some achievements that were not working properly.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes: Fixed the "KILL ALL KINDS OF ENEMIES" achievement that was not working properly.
